title: Same launch listed several times
paras: The first live sweep listed IndusInd's corporate card and SBI's FD-backed card three times each, under different headline wordings (“Launches FD-Backed Credit Card”, “Advantage SBI Card”, “FD-backed YONO SBI Card”). An ad also produced a generic “SBI Credit Cards” candidate.
Group leads by issuer plus fuzzy-matched card name, and drop generic names before discovery. About 30 minutes with tests.
note: New: same launch listed several times
